mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month indicates a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 1% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, which boosts liquidity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% MoM and UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% quarter-over-quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) is stagnant or declining, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and INDPRO stagnant/declining
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and INDPRO stagnant/declining and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
